prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. Her hand at the shoe draws the yellow card out of the window and carries it low over the felt towards its place well to the right of the middle of the picture, in front of the shoe, where the last frame shows it. On the way her hand turns the card over once, holding it the whole time, and lays it flat at its place, blue side up. Then her open hand glides back low over the felt, palm down, to the shoe and takes the next card. The other hand rests on the felt. Only one card moves; its back is yellow and its face is blue.
